plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: SARANA uses your location to place your report in the right GN division so responders can reach you. It is never tracked in the background.

plugins.cameraPermission: SARANA attaches a photo to your report so responders can assess the situation before they arrive.

plugins.microphonePermission: SARANA records a short voice note so you can report in Sinhala or Tamil without typing.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SARANA uses your location to place your report in the right GN division so responders can reach you.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SARANA records a short voice note so you can report in Sinhala or Tamil without typing.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SARANA attaches a photo to your report so responders can assess the situation before they arrive.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: SARANA saves a copy of the photo you attach so it survives a failed upload.
